info.sub_ename: COMMUNICATION BETWEEN CULTURES: INTRODUCTION TO CROSS-CULTURAL STUDIES

description.sub_ename: COMMUNICATION BETWEEN CULTURES: INTRODUCTION TO CROSS-CULTURAL STUDIES
description.describe_ch: 本課程結合跨文化溝通、語用學與社會語言學等領域的理論、研究方法以及實務議題，探討語言與文化的關係，讓學生瞭解語言、社會與文化三個層面的相互影響，並運用所學去評論相關領域的文章，進而從事小規模的研究，實際洞悉語言與文化的關係。
description.describe_eh: The course focuses on the relationship between language and culture, with an introduction to some theoretical, methodological and practical issues in the fields of cross-cultural/intercultural communication, pragmatics and sociolinguistics. The course aims to provide insights into the interaction between linguistic, social and cultural dimensions. By having the theoretical and methodological knowledge, students will learn to critique research papers in the abovementioned fields and conduct a small-scale study to explore the relationship between language and culture.

targets.describe_ch: 理解語言、社會與文化間的關係。
targets.describe_en: Demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between language, society and culture.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由評論實證研究，培養並運用分析與批判思考的能力。
targets.describe_en: Develop and apply analytical skill and critical thinking through critiques of empirical studies.

targets.describe_ch: 覺察並尊重溝通上的文化差異。
targets.describe_en: Raise an awareness of and respect cultural differences in communication.

readings.tpc_book: Other References are to be assigned in class.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading:
Group work I: Co-Profile Building
Activity: In-class exercise

Cross-Cultural Communication in Literature
Ref. “The Task of the Translator”, Walter Benjamin

Group Work II: Experiment and Exercise
Activity: Exploring project methods

Discussion and/or invited speech and workshop
Invited lecture. Evie Willems

Field Research Session 2
Presentations and group discussion based on Field Research 1.

Cross-Cultural Communication in Visual/Acoustic Representation
Ref. Rada Iveković, William B. Gudykunst, and Young Yun Kim

Group work III: place-based story telling
Activity: Students will engage in storytelling activities centered on places that hold personal or cultural significance.

Field Research Session 2
Presentations and group discussion based on Field Research 1.

Group Work IV: Project preparation
Activity: Begin developing final projects. Develop a creative or research-based project that expands upon the themes explored in Group Work III, particularly cross-cultural storytelling, and place-based communication.
Note: Projects may be completed individually or as group work.

gradeRules.evalb_memo:
Participation & Engagement 
Includes attendance (in class and during field trips), active participation in discussions, teamwork, and contribution to group activities.

Group Work and in site participation
Collaborative development  that reflects both classroom learning and field experience. Teamwork and creativity will be assessed.

Final Project 
Full participation in four structured exercises, which are essential for building toward the final presentation. Completion of all tasks is required.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
1. Understand the basic concepts of intercultural communication.
  2. Engage in in-class exercises and discussions.
  3. Participate in field-based workshops and field research.
  4. Complete a project presentation.
  5. Build networks for intercultural communication.
  6. Understand intercultural phenomena in language learning, literature, and other medium.
  7. Examine the current state of global mobility in contemporary times.
